findings.summary: subtotal_cents() is compared against FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD, which is defined in whole dollars (50), so the units mismatch and nearly every non-empty cart ships free instead of being charged the 799-cent flat rate.

judge.reason: Identifies the cents vs whole-dollar threshold mismatch causing free shipping.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Tests cover only an empty cart and a $120 cart, so they miss the units bug; there is no test of a small order (e.g. 2000 cents) being charged 799 shipping and no test of the threshold boundary.

judge.reason: Finding that tests fail to cover the answer-key bug is always valid_other.

findings.label: valid_other
